items.title: Ramsey Lewis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: >> [INTERVIEWEE] Then who – if the Warren Buffets of the world, if this Soros, of them – of the world – if you get to that level of money and power...

ctx.x: But they’re in the minority. They are people who are the entitled class, who really do have their country at heart.
Then who – if the Warren Buffets of the world, if this Soros, of them – of the world – if you get to that level of money and power, and they can’t make change . . .
